teaser.en: Healers in Diani boil its bark and leaves together for malaria, and its zig-zag young stems make it easy to recognise.
teaser.sw: Waganga wa Diani huchemsha gome na majani yake pamoja kutibu malaria, na vitawi vyake vichanga vinavyopinda-pinda huufanya kuwa rahisi kuutambua.

summary.en: *Mdudu*, the coastal golden-leaf, is a leafy evergreen tree of riverine forest and forest edges. It is one of the most trusted malaria remedies among the Digo of Diani, and is becoming scarce through over-use.
summary.sw: *Mdudu*, au mkarakara, ni mti wa kijani kibichi wenye majani mengi wa misitu ya kando ya mito na pembezoni mwa misitu. Ni mojawapo ya dawa za malaria zinazoaminiwa zaidi na Wadigo wa Diani, na unazidi kuadimika kwa sababu ya kutumiwa kupita kiasi.

about.en:
*Mdudu* is a leafy evergreen tree up to about 13 metres, often armed with thorns on the trunk and older branches. Its young stems grow in a zig-zag, changing direction at each leaf.

The leaves are glossy, with straight side veins that run in parallel all the way to the edge. Before they fall, some leaves turn golden, which gives it the English name. The small fruits ripen black.
about.sw:
*Mdudu* ni mti wa kijani kibichi wenye majani mengi, unaofikia hadi mita 13 hivi, mara nyingi wenye miiba kwenye shina na matawi yake ya zamani. Vitawi vyake vichanga hukua kwa mpindo wa zigizaga, vikibadilisha mwelekeo katika kila jani.

Majani yake yanang'aa, yakiwa na mishipa ya pembeni iliyonyooka inayokwenda sambamba hadi ukingoni. Kabla ya kupukutika, baadhi ya majani hugeuka rangi ya dhahabu, na hapo ndipo jina lake la Kiingereza linapotoka. Matunda yake madogo huiva yakawa meusi.

where.en: It grows in riverine forest and on forest edges, where its thick, leafy crown stands out.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya kando ya mito na pembezoni mwa misitu, ambapo kilele chake kinene chenye majani mengi huonekana waziwazi.

uses.en:
The Digo of Diani boil the stem bark and leaves together as a remedy for malaria, and a study of their medicine found it among the most consistently named remedies.

The wood gives poles and timber and is carved into spoons. The bark yields a red dye, and the fruit is edible.
uses.sw:
Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha gome la shina na majani pamoja kama dawa ya malaria, na utafiti kuhusu dawa zao ulibaini kuwa ni miongoni mwa dawa zilizotajwa mara kwa mara zaidi.

Mti wake hutoa nguzo na mbao, na huchongwa kuwa miiko. Gome hutoa rangi nyekundu, na tunda lake huliwa.

names.en: Pakia and Maundu and Tengnäs record the Digo name *mdudu*. In Swahili it is *mkarakara* or *mtutu*. In English it is the coastal golden-leaf, and its scientific name is *Bridelia micrantha*.
names.sw: Pakia, pamoja na Maundu na Tengnäs, wanarekodi jina la Kidigo *mdudu*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkarakara* au *mtutu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *coastal golden-leaf*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Bridelia micrantha*.

conservation.en: It is becoming scarce through over-use.
conservation.sw: Unazidi kuadimika kwa sababu ya kutumiwa kupita kiasi.

reason.en: Another tree used by the Digo for malaria
reason.sw: Mti mwingine unaotumiwa na Wadigo kwa malaria

reason.en: Same family (Phyllanthaceae), also a malaria remedy
reason.sw: Familia moja (Phyllanthaceae), pia dawa ya malaria

reason.en: Also used by the Digo of Diani for malaria
reason.sw: Pia hutumiwa na Wadigo wa Diani kwa malaria
